about: Evaluator-only gold claim specification, built mechanically from the gold CSV by variant2mechanism.v9.evaluation.build_gold_spec. Review every needs_review item, then set status to 'reviewed'; until then every score against this spec is provisional. The CSV is never edited; the engine never reads this file.

rules.tf_member: strict: the answer names the gold TF itself (HGNC symbol), as a TF or as a participant of a complex or binding event; naming its model-sharing group is not member credit
rules.tf_group: lenient: the answer names a QBiC-SELEX model-sharing group holding the gold TF (cache/groups.json), or any TF of such a group
rules.tf_family: lenient: the answer names any TF of the gold TF's Lambert 2018 DBD family; not applicable when the gold TF is not in QBiC-SELEX coverage (score_level not_in_coverage), because the right answer there is that it cannot be assessed, not a modelled relative
rules.direction: the binding change of the alt allele relative to ref, read from the direction text; compared with the answer's alters_binding claims about a TF matching at member, group or family level (member level only when the gold TF is not in QBiC-SELEX coverage)
rules.target_gene: the answer names one of the genes (HGNC symbols)
rules.context: an answer context matches a gold scope exactly or as a proxy (v9 context_match)
rules.phenotype: the answer's endpoint or a phenotype it names contains every word of a gold trait; not scored when the run was given the disease
rules.answer: the claims that stand of the leading or tied hypotheses the run's result names (a result decided without a final comparison names none, and the audit names none in its place): a claim the run assessed contradicted_in_scope, a superseded claim and a claim about another variant (by the graph's claim_frame, under which an rsID code recorded for the case variant, or its chrom:pos, names the case) earn nothing
rules.outcome: an explanation (leading_explanation, partial_mechanism, multiple_explanations), an abstention (no_supported_explanation) or a limitation (input_or_capability_limitation). A run stopped by engine_error or cache_miss, whatever outcome it recorded, or refused as input (input_invalid, unsupported_variant), assessed nothing: a case-level failure to report and rerun, scored as neither a miss nor an abstention nor a control's null. A limitation the run concluded itself is its answer
rules.controls: no component applies: the audit records the outcome and any supported causal claim of the answer (controls are evidence-sparse comparisons, not established biological nulls); a run that assessed nothing is not a null
rules.denominators: a component counts only where it applies, the run assessed the case (see outcome), the run was not given it as input and its gold value is defined
rules.review: every score is provisional until the spec's status is 'reviewed'; after that, a component still marked needs_review stays provisional
rules.row: each case keeps its CSV row as read: the isolation check derives the gold label strings from it, so it is never edited in the review (the CSV is the source)
